ابتليا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَلَيَا (ibtalayā) /ib.ta.la.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
# اُبْتُلِيَا (ubtuliyā) /ub.tu.li.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
# اِبْتَلِيَا (ibtaliyā) /ib.ta.li.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
